rows.grounds: locative sense on the left side
compound naming interval between pillar and crest
demonstrative referring to the named interval

items.question: What interval is specified between the pillar and crest on the left side?
items.inference: the left-side pillar-crest interval is the designated measure
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of stambha and cūḍā is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: And on the left, indeed, that is the pillar-crest interval.
